notes: Rewrote the About section as marketing rather than a spec sheet. It now leads with what is actually happening under the glass and why anyone would want to look at it, and it leans on the language the product already speaks — Sigil, glints…

The theme is sold as the thing it is: not a colour picker, but a switch that transfigures type, spacing, shape and motion across the Control Panel and your glints at once. Same machine, same numbers, different spell.
